bullets.section: What I’m reading and forwarding to all of my friends —
bullets.title: Business gets ready to trip: How psychedelic drugs may revolutionize mental health care
bullets.creator: Jeffrey O’Brien
bullets.note:
fourhourmail.com/c/o8uvgq544hqhgg6xval/opfkhqhl0e67z4/aHR0cHM6Ly90d2l0dGVyLmNvbS9qZWZmcmV5b2JyaWVuLw==)) in _Fortune_. I don’t do much media these days, but I made a huge exception for this one, as it should be huge: 12–16 pages in the print edition, making it the largest feature in the issue.  
  
It’s one of the best articles on psychedelics I’ve seen in years, and it covers a lot of important ground: business, nonprofit, scientific, and investment considerations, among others. As one friend said about the piece: “Finally, this is the article I can send my parents to explain why this is so important.” If the article resonates with you as well, please consider sharing it. It can have a large impact.  
  
Much gratitude to Jeffrey for diving so deep in this writing, and huge thanks to Alexandra and Steven and team at the Cohen Foundation ([@cohengive](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/o8uvgq544hqhgg6xval/pxteh9h5pe2lvz/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuaW5zdGFncmFtLmNvbS9jb2hlbmdpdmUvP2hsPWVu)), Matt Mullenweg ([@photomatt](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/o8uvgq544hqhgg6xval/6mceh8h6345dql/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuaW5zdGFncmFtLmNvbS9waG90b21hdHQvP2hsPWVu)), Blake Mycoskie ([@blakemycoskie](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/o8uvgq544hqhgg6xval/5osvh7ho4wnzek/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuaW5zdGFncmFtLmNvbS9ibGFrZW15Y29za2llLz9obD1lbg==)), and Craig Nerenberg for helping set [such an ambitious example at Johns Hopkins](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/o8uvgq544hqhgg6xval/qea8h7h2l340xn/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cubnl0aW1lcy5jb20vMjAxOS8wOS8wNC9zY2llbmNlL3BzeWNoZWRlbGljLWRydWdzLWhvcGtpbnMtZGVwcmVzc2lvbi5odG1sP3NlYXJjaFJlc3VsdFBvc2l0aW9uPTE=). Just wait for the rest of 2020… there are some BIG things coming.

And for fun, here’s the _Fortune_ sub-headline: “Silicon Valley legends. Billionaire financiers. Patent attorneys. They’re all awakening to the massive potential of an industry preparing to emerge from darkness.”  
  
(Last note: It takes less than 15 seconds to register to read the full piece. You do not need to pay or enter credit card information. Just confirm your email.)

bullets.section: Tool I’ve been using a lot this week —
bullets.title: Archive.today
bullets.note: or** [**Archive.is**](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/o8uvgq544hqhgg6xval/r3i8hohvop3e84/aHR0cHM6Ly9hcmNoaXZlLmlzLw==) **(identical).** Here’s the official description: “Archive.today is a time capsule for web pages! It takes a ‘snapshot’ of a webpage that will always be online even if the original page disappears. It saves a text and a graphical copy of the page for better accuracy and provides a short and reliable link to an unalterable record of any web page.” Normally, I use the [Evernote web clipper](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/o8uvgq544hqhgg6xval/vlf3hrh3q6vd5r/aHR0cHM6Ly9ldmVybm90ZS5jb20vZmVhdHVyZXMvd2ViY2xpcHBlcg==) for grabbing web content, and many friends use [Pocket](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/o8uvgq544hqhgg6xval/mpt7h5h0lxq7rp/aHR0cHM6Ly9nZXRwb2NrZXQuY29tLw==), but [Archive.is](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/o8uvgq544hqhgg6xval/vrc3hrh3q6vd5l/aHR0cHM6Ly9hcmNoaXZlLmlzLw==) has some unique features and benefits worth exploring…
